slides.dek: We gave five animals a review form. They did not hold back.

slides.name: The Dog
slides.meta: Has never had a bad day
slides.title: 10/10 would recommend
slides.body: You leave. Then you come back. Every single time. Best plot twist ever written. Also sometimes you drop cheese.

slides.name: The Pigeon
slides.title: Great infrastructure
slides.body: You built an entire statue for me to sit on. You didn't have to do that. The fries on the ground are also free. City of legends.

slides.name: The Goldfish
slides.title: Wait, what was I reviewing
slides.body: The big face appears and food falls from the sky. Four stars. Docking one because I no longer remember why I'm here.

slides.name: The Raccoon
slides.title: You throw away FEASTS
slides.body: An entire pizza. In the bin. Untouched. Either you are all rich or you are all fools. Five stars. Keep it coming.

slides.name: The Cat
slides.title: The staff is needy
slides.body: The lap kept moving. I asked for silence and received baby talk. One star. I will be back tonight.
Follow before the cat reviews you personally.
